title: Shadows MCP Server
description: Embeds an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in the game so AI assistants and scripts can query the live game state and command your agents over HTTP. Query the world map, units, people, factions, religions, wars, threats and the hero investigations closing in on you, plus your god's powers and win-condition; move agents, perform challenges, use powers, recruit, resolve decisions and end the turn.
